summary: Consolidated Water Co. Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting that on June 18, 2026, its subsidiary Cayman Water received a new license from the Cayman Islands utility regulator OfReg to produce and distribute potable water within its service area. This is a regulatory/operational update, not a special situation. No financial terms, premium, or strategic corporate event are involved. The filing details the background of the prior license and negotiations. As a routine regulatory milestone, it does not trigger any of the listed special-situation categories.
